D) It repeats precedent on a regular basis

lines.t: Many dog owners would tell you that their dog somehow knows when they're ill or upset, and according to researchers who study dog cognition, those pet owners are right.
lines.zh: 许多狗主会告诉你 他们的狗不知何故知道 当他们生病或心烦意乱, 根据研究狗认知的研究人员, 那些宠物主是正确的.
cloze: Many dog owners would tell you that their dog somehow knows when they're ill or upset, and according to
who study dog cognition, those pet owners are right.

lines.t: Dogs do know when their human companions are having a rough time.
lines.zh: 狗们知道它们的人类同伴 什么时候过得很艰难.

lines.t: Not only can your dog sense when you have a cold, but domestic dogs have shown an aptitude for detecting both much smaller mood fluctuations and far more serious physical conditions.
lines.zh: 不仅你的狗在感冒时能感觉到, 而且家犬也显示出了 探测更小的情绪波动 和更严重的身体条件的能力.
cloze: Not only can your dog sense when you have a cold, but domestic dogs have shown an aptitude for detecting both much smaller mood
and far more serious physical conditions.

lines.t: This is because dogs are extremely sensitive to changes in the people they're familiar with, and illness causes change.
lines.zh: 这是因为狗对所熟悉的人的变化极为敏感,而疾病导致变化.

lines.t: If a person is infected with a virus or bacteria, for example, their odor will be abnormal, and dogs are able to smell that change even if the human can't, because dogs have a much more powerful sense of smell than humans.
lines.zh: 例如,如果一个人感染了病毒或细菌,他们的气味就会异常,而狗即使人类不能闻到这种变化,因为狗的嗅觉比人类强得多.
cloze: If a person is infected with a virus or bacteria, for example, their odor will be abnormal, and dogs are able to smell that change even if the human can't, because dogs have a much more
sense of smell than humans.

lines.t: Researchers have also found that a person's mood, which can be an indicator of a larger illness, triggers a dog's sense of smell.
lines.zh: 研究者还发现,一个人的情绪,可以作为较大疾病的指标,会触发狗的嗅觉.

lines.t: Human emotions manifest physically in chemical signals that are emitted by the body, and dogs are able to smell those as well.
lines.zh: 人类的情绪在身体释放的化学信号中表现出来,而狗也能闻到这些.
cloze: Human emotions manifest physically in
signals that are emitted by the body, and dogs are able to smell those as well.

lines.t: Beyond smell, dogs gather information from a person's voice in order to sense changes.
lines.zh: 在嗅觉之外,狗从一个人的声音中收集信息,以感知变化.

lines.t: In 2014, researchers discovered that dogs have an area of the brain similar to one in humans that allows them to understand emotional cues in the tone of a speaker's voice, beyond what they'd be able to pick up from familiar words alone.
lines.zh: 2014年,研究者发现狗脑有一个类似于人类大脑的区域,使得它们能够用扬声器的基调来理解情绪提示,超越了它们单独从熟悉的文字中能够取出的东西.
cloze: In 2014, researchers discovered that dogs have an area of the brain similar to one in humans that allows them to understand
cues in the tone of a speaker's voice, beyond what they'd be able to pick up from familiar words alone.

lines.t: A person's voice can also carry indicators of illness.
lines.zh: 一个人的声音也可以携带疾病的指标.

lines.t: What's not understood quite so well is what dogs understand about these changes.
lines.zh: 不太清楚的是狗对这些变化的理解.
cloze: What's not understood quite so well is what dogs
about these changes.

lines.t: Humans send out lots of cues, but whether dogs know some of these cues mean illness isn't clear.
lines.zh: 人类发出许多提示, 但狗是否知道一些这些提示意味着疾病是不清楚的.

lines.t: What we perceive as concern on a dog's part might be more like increased curiosity or suspicion that something is wrong with us, and sticking close by is a great way to gather more information about the situation.
lines.zh: 我们所认为的对狗的关心,可能更像是增加好奇心或怀疑我们有什么不对劲,而坚持靠拢是收集更多有关局势的信息的好办法.
cloze: What we perceive as concern on a dog's part might be more like increased curiosity or suspicion that something is wrong with us, and sticking close by is a great way to gather more
about the situation.

lines.t: Some researchers assert dogs will one day help doctors diagnose diseases, as some dogs have already demonstrated the ability to detect an assortment of ailments, including diabetes and certain types of cancer.
lines.zh: 一些研究者断言有朝一日狗会帮助医生诊断出疾病,因为有的狗已经证明有能力检测出各种疾病,包括糖尿病和某些类型的癌症.

lines.t: But those researchers concede that's probably in the distant future.
lines.zh: 但是那些研究者承认 这可能是在遥远的未来.
cloze: But those
concede that's probably in the distant future.

lines.t: For now, research suggests dog ownership can have an array of benefits in and of itself.
lines.zh: 目前,研究表明狗的所有权本身可以产生一系列好处.

lines.t: Keeping a pet dog has been shown to bolster health and boost mood.
lines.zh: 养一只宠物狗可以增强健康和情绪.
cloze: Keeping a pet dog has been shown to
health and boost mood.

lines.t: Dogs also help people relax, and they can be a particular comfort to those with chronic diseases.
lines.zh: 狗也帮助人们放松,对有慢性病的人来说,狗可以是一种特殊的安慰.

lines.t: Earlier this month, the think-tank called Onward published a report, "A Question of Degree", which argues that degrees in the creative arts are not good value for money.
lines.zh: 本月早些时候,名为"Onward"的智囊团发表了一份报告"学位问题",该报告认为,创作艺术中的学位不具有良好的金钱价值.
cloze: Earlier this month, the think-tank called Onward published a report, "A Question of Degree", which argues that degrees in the
arts are not good value for money.

lines.t: Ministers, according to Onward, should "crack down on courses that offer extremely limited value for money to students ten years after graduation", restricting the ability of such courses to recruit new students, if the average graduate earns below the student loans payment threshold.
lines.zh: 根据Onward的说法,如果平均毕业生收入低于学生贷款支付门槛,部长们应该"在毕业后10年向学生提供极其有限的金钱价值的课程上打压",限制这类课程招聘新生的能力.

lines.t: Courses like science, technology, engineering, and math, and economics, where the average graduate earns a lot, should be favored.
lines.zh: 科学、技术、工程、数学和经济学等课程,如果平均毕业生收入很高,应该受到青睐.
cloze: Courses like science, technology,
, and math, and economics, where the average graduate earns a lot, should be favored.

lines.t: The report provides insight into a government review which looks at how to reform technical education and how to ensure students get good value for money.
lines.zh: 报告提供了对政府审查的见解,该审查审视了如何改革技术教育以及如何确保学生获得良好的资金价值.

lines.t: At first glance, it might even seem like Onward have a point.
lines.zh: 乍一看,它甚至可能 看起来像Onward有一点.

lines.t: According to their data, the majority of creative arts students earn less than 25,000 pounds a year, ten years after graduation.
lines.zh: 根据他们的数据,大多数创意艺术学生在毕业后10年,每年收入不到25,000磅.

lines.t: The average male creative arts students, indeed, apparently earn much less than they would, had they simply never gone to university.
lines.zh: 事实上,男性创作艺术学生如果从未上过大学,收入显然比他们低得多.
cloze: The average male creative arts students, indeed, apparently earn much less than they would, had they simply never gone to

lines.t: This isn't really good for anyone, and it's certainly no good for graduates, who are forced to endure a lifestyle where they can never save up, never buy a house, never hope to retire.
lines.zh: 这对任何人都不好, 这对毕业生当然也不好, 他们被迫忍受一种生活方式, 他们永远不能储蓄, 永远不能买房子, 永远不能退休.

lines.t: Onward have identified a real problem.
lines.zh: 接下来,我们发现了一个真正的问题.
cloze: Onward have
a real problem.

lines.t: Creative arts graduates from top universities — like Oxford, with a high proportion of privately-educated students — have fairly good work prospects.
lines.zh: 来自顶尖大学的创意艺术毕业生——如牛津大学,受过私人教育的学生比例很高——工作前景相当好.

lines.t: Well, 40 percent of all graduates — regardless of their degree — are on less than 25,000 pounds a year, 5 years after graduation.
lines.zh: 40%的毕业生——无论学位如何—— 在毕业5年后,每年的体重不到25,000磅.
cloze: Well, 40 percent of all graduates — regardless of their degree — are on less than 25,000 pounds a year, 5 years after

lines.t: This suggests that the problem isn't really to do with specific students studying specific degrees, but really with the economy as a whole.
lines.zh: 这表明问题并不真正与特定学生学习特定学位有关,而是真正与整个经济有关.

lines.t: Regardless of what they've studied, young people find it hard to get ahead unless they're lucky enough to be born with successful parents.
lines.zh: 不论他们研究了什么,除非他们幸运地与成功的父母相生,否则年轻人发现很难提前.
cloze: Regardless of what they've studied, young people find it hard to get ahead unless they're lucky enough to be born with
parents.

lines.t: If ministers want to make education pay for young people, they need to look beyond the higher education sector, towards the wider world.
lines.zh: 如果部长们想让年轻人获得教育报酬,他们就必须超越高等教育部门,面向更广阔的世界.

lines.t: The rewards that education gives us are not measurable.
lines.zh: 教育给我们的回报是无法衡量的.
cloze: The rewards that education gives us are not

lines.t: They are not always instantly obvious, and certainly not always direct.
lines.zh: 它们并不总是立即显现的,当然并不总是直接的.

lines.t: An education makes you a different person from the one you would have been if you hadn't received it.
lines.zh: 教育使你与如果没有接受教育 你本会是不同的人.
cloze: An
makes you a different person from the one you would have been if you hadn't received it.

lines.t: We need to look at the value of education not in the context of a bank balance, but of a life.
lines.zh: 我们需要审视教育的价值,不是从银行余额的角度,而是从生活的角度.

lines.t: If we continue to allow ourselves to be distracted with talk of "value for money", we will all be made poorer as a result.
lines.zh: 如果我们继续让自己被"金钱价值"的说辞所分心,我们就会因此变得更穷.
cloze: If we continue to allow ourselves to be
with talk of "value for money", we will all be made poorer as a result.

lines.t: So, I've been thinking, this summer, instead of our usual holiday rental, I'd like to try renting a camper van and exploring a bit more.
lines.zh: 所以,我一直在想, 今年夏天, 而不是我们通常的假日租金, 我想尝试租一辆露营车, 并探索更多.
cloze: So, I've been thinking, this summer, instead of our usual
I'd like to try renting a camper van and exploring a bit more.

lines.t: A camper van?
lines.zh: 一辆露营车?

lines.t: You mean to spend the summer living out of a car?

cloze: You mean to spend the
out of a car?

living out of a car.

lines.t: Some even have kitchens.
lines.zh: 有些人甚至有厨房.

lines.t: This way, we wouldn't have to be locked into one place during our holiday.
lines.zh: 这样的话,我们不用在节日被锁在一个地方.

lines.t: We'd be able to visit so many more places and travel at our own pace.

at our own pace.

lines.t: We'd probably save a lot of money as well.

a lot of money as well.

that appealing to me.

lines.t: You wanted to see me?
lines.zh: 你想见我?

lines.t: Yes, I'll get straight to the point.
lines.zh: 是的,我直说吧.

lines.zh: 在过去的一个月内,你的表现显然已经下降.
cloze: Over the past month or so, it has become apparent that your
has dipped.

lines.t: You've been late to work several times these past few weeks, which is very uncharacteristic of you.
lines.zh: 这几周你来上班已经迟了好几次了 这很不典型.

lines.t: But what really concerns me is your curtailed output.
lines.zh: 但真正让我担心的是 你的减速输出.
cloze: But what really concerns me is your
output.

lines.t: Lately, you seem to be constantly one step behind.

lines.t: I'm sorry.

lines.zh: 我现在正经历一些不幸的家庭问题.

family issues at the moment.

lines.t: Nevertheless, I expect it to have all blown over in another month or so.
lines.zh: 尽管如此,我期望它已经 全部在另一个月左右.

lines.t: Do you need some time off?
lines.zh: 你需要休息吗?

lines.t: Actually, yes.
lines.zh: 事实上是的.

lines.t: Would it be possible to take the next two Mondays off?
lines.zh: 下两个星期一可以休息吗?

lines.zh: 我当时在考虑我是否该问这个 但现在我们在这里...

whether I should ask for this, but now that we're here...

lines.t: There are many factors that impact our health.
lines.zh: 影响我们健康的因素很多.
cloze: There are many factors that
our health.

lines.t: These include our finances, our emotions and the way we work.
lines.zh: 其中包括我们的财政,我们的情绪和我们的工作方式.

lines.t: Education is one such factor.
lines.zh: 教育就是其中之一.

lines.t: Research suggests that higher levels of education can lead to better health and even greater longevity.
lines.zh: 研究表明,更高的教育水平可以导致更好的健康甚至更长的寿命.

lines.t: But what about the education of your partner?
lines.zh: 但你伴侣的教育呢?
cloze: But what about the
of your partner?

lines.t: New research seeks to answer this question.
lines.zh: 新的研究寻求回答这个问题.

lines.t: Researchers use data from a longitudinal study.
lines.zh: 研究人员使用纵向研究的数据.
cloze: Researchers use data from a
study.

lines.t: The data came from surveys first administered to high school seniors in 1957.
lines.zh: 这些数据来自1957年首次对高中毕业生进行的调查.

lines.t: The surveys ended in 2011.
lines.zh: 调查于2011年结束.

lines.t: The team found that a person whose spouse had a higher level of education tended to report better health.
lines.zh: 调查组发现,配偶受教育程度较高的人往往报告健康状况较好.

lines.t: This remained the case when adjusting for other factors, such as participants' own education, social background and health status before and after marriage.
lines.zh: 在对其他因素进行调整时,如参与者自己的教育、社会背景和婚前及婚后健康状况,情况仍然如此.
cloze: This remained the case when adjusting for other factors, such as participants' own
, social background and health status before and after marriage.

lines.t: The authors suggest that high levels of education provide shared social, intellectual, emotional and financial resources.
lines.zh: 作者认为,高水平的教育提供了共同的社会、知识、情感和财政资源.

lines.t: These include things like higher levels of emotional intelligence, particular skills or knowledge, or more money.
lines.zh: 这些包括诸如更高层次的情感智能,特殊技能或知识,或更多金钱等.
cloze: These include things like higher levels of emotional
, particular skills or knowledge, or more money.

lines.t: The researchers concede that an individual's own level of education is clearly important for their health, but they assert that individuals also can reap the benefits of their partner's education.
lines.zh: 研究人员承认,个人的教育水平显然对其健康很重要,但他们声称,个人也可以从伴侣的教育中获益.

lines.t: It is noteworthy that the effects vary by gender.
lines.zh: 值得注意的是,影响因性别而异.
cloze: It is
that the effects vary by gender.

lines.t: For women, health was more closely correlated to their spouse's education than for men.
lines.zh: 对于妇女来说,健康与其配偶的教育关系更为密切.

lines.t: The team suggests this may be related to the time period of the study.
lines.zh: 小组建议这可能与研究的时间段有关.
cloze: The team
this may be related to the time period of the study.

lines.t: Women in this sample had lower levels of education and lower occupational achievements than the men.
lines.zh: 在这一抽样中,妇女的教育水平较低,职业成就低于男子.

lines.t: The researchers' hypothesis is that this made the husband's resources more likely to have a shared impact.
lines.zh: 研究者的假设是,这使得丈夫的资源更有可能产生共同的影响.

more likely to have a shared impact.

lines.t: Climate scientists predict that many parts of the world will be increasingly prone to floods.
lines.zh: 气候科学家预测,世界许多地方将越来越容易发生洪水.
cloze: Climate scientists predict that many parts of the world will be
prone to floods.

lines.t: This is a serious risk to human lives and property.
lines.zh: 这是对人类生命和财产的严重威胁.

lines.t: So understanding and accurately forecasting flood risks is a key challenge for vulnerable cities around the globe.
lines.zh: 因此,了解和准确预测洪水风险是全球脆弱城市面临的一个关键挑战.
cloze: So
and accurately forecasting flood risks is a key challenge for vulnerable cities around the globe.

lines.t: In 2017, Derek Loftis of the Virginia Institute of Marine Science started a project called Catch the King.
lines.zh: 2017年,弗吉尼亚海洋科学研究所的德里克·洛夫蒂斯(德語:Derek Loftis)开始了名为Catch the King的项目.

lines.t: It uses a smartphone app to collect the data of ordinary citizens during high tides.
lines.zh: 它使用智能手机应用来收集高潮时期普通公民的数据.
cloze: It uses a smartphone app to collect the data of
citizens during high tides.

lines.t: He'll use those data to validate and improve his mathematical flooding model, called TideWatch.
lines.zh: 他会用这些数据来验证和改进他的数学洪水模型,叫做潮汐观察.

lines.t: Loftis's mission is to know where the water goes before it goes there.
lines.zh: 洛夫蒂斯的任务是在水去之前先知道水到哪里去.
cloze: Loftis's
is to know where the water goes before it goes there.

lines.t: But collecting necessary data and then processing that information quickly enough to make usable forecasts is anything but easy.
lines.zh: 但是,收集必要的数据,然后迅速处理这些信息,以便作出有用的预测,这绝非易事.

lines.t: Accurate flood forecasts require an understanding of the situation on the ground.
lines.zh: 准确的洪水预报需要了解当地的情况.
cloze: Accurate flood forecasts require an
of the situation on the ground.

lines.t: By the early 2000s, supercomputing had advanced enough that scientists could integrate weather forecasting models with such measurements.
lines.zh: 到2000年代初期,超级计算已经取得了足够的进展,科学家可以将天气预报模型同这种测量方法结合起来.

lines.t: But they still didn't have the critically important ability to forecast fast-moving floods in real time.
lines.zh: 但他们仍然没有至关重要的能力实时预报快速移动的洪水.
cloze: But they still didn't have the critically important ability to forecast
floods in real time.

lines.t: So, in 2017, Loftis and colleagues set up a group of 28 Internet-connected water-level sensors throughout the flood risk community of Norfolk, Virginia.
lines.zh: 因此,在2017年,洛夫蒂斯和同僚在弗吉尼亚州诺福克的洪水风险社区建立了由28个互联网连接的水位传感器组成的小组.

lines.t: The new sensors relayed rough measurements about water height and movement to a computer at the Virginia Institute.
lines.zh: 新的传感器将关于水高和移动的粗略测量结果转发给弗吉尼亚研究所的一台计算机.
cloze: The new sensors relayed rough
about water height and movement to a computer at the Virginia Institute.

lines.t: Along with those sensors, hundreds of local citizens take photos of rising tides and transmit them in real time to the institute.
lines.zh: 与这些传感器一起,成百上千的当地公民拍摄了涨潮的照片并实时传送到研究所.

lines.t: Scientists hope that the data collected by these citizens can help sharpen the ability to forecast exactly when and where damaging floods will occur.
lines.zh: 科学家希望这些公民所收集的数据能够帮助加强准确预测何时何地将发生破坏性洪水的能力.
cloze: Scientists hope that the data collected by these citizens can help sharpen the ability to forecast exactly when and where
floods will occur.

lines.t: Now, it's become something of a ritual to debate the value of a college degree, but as Current Population Survey data show, there has been a sharp decline in employment among men without college degrees compared with those who have them.
lines.zh: 现在,争论大学学位的价值已经成为一种仪式,但正如"当前人口调查"的数据显示,与那些拥有大学学位的人相比,没有大学学位的男性的就业率急剧下降.
cloze: Now, it's become something of a ritual to debate the value of a college degree, but as Current Population Survey data show, there has been a sharp decline in
among men without college degrees compared with those who have them.

lines.t: This decline began in the 1960s and has become more serious over time.
lines.zh: 这一下降始于1960年代,并随着时间的推移变得更加严重.

lines.t: What has actually caused this decline?
lines.zh: 是什么导致了这种下降?
cloze: What has actually caused this

lines.t: Well, economists have been working to ascertain the roots of the decline for decades and have come up with several theories.
lines.zh: 几十年来,经济学家一直致力于查明衰退的根源,并提出了几种理论.

lines.t: One popular theory is that it's a case of too low wages for jobs that don't require a degree.
lines.zh: 一个流行的理论是,对于不需要学位的工作来说,这是工资过低的案例.
cloze: One popular theory is that it's a case of too low wages for jobs that don't
a degree.

lines.t: An alternate theory is that there were more jobs not requiring a college degree in the past than now.
lines.zh: 另一种理论是,过去不需要大学学位的工作比现在多.

lines.t: A recent working paper from the National Bureau of Economic Research reviewed those theories and put forward additional hypotheses about the causes of the problem.
lines.zh: 国家经济研究局最近的一份工作文件审查了这些理论,并提出了更多关于问题根源的假设.
cloze: A recent working paper from the National Bureau of Economic Research reviewed those theories and put forward
hypotheses about the causes of the problem.

lines.t: Let's look at that paper now.
lines.zh: 让我们看看那篇论文吧.

lines.t: First, the researchers considered the issue of wages.
lines.zh: 首先,研究人员审议了工资问题.
cloze: First, the
considered the issue of wages.

lines.t: As the wage gap has grown between those with college degrees and those without, economists have suggested that men aren't as interested in taking some of the less lucrative jobs.
lines.zh: 由于有大学学位的人和没有大学学位的人之间的工资差距越来越大,经济学家认为,男人对从事一些不太赚钱的工作没有兴趣.

lines.t: While the authors of the paper found truth in this explanation, they assert that low wages can't be the only factor, as wages for men without college degrees, adjusting for inflation, haven't changed much since the 1960s, making it hard to see why fewer men seem willing to accept those wages.
lines.zh: 虽然论文的作者从这个解释中发现了事实,但他们断言低工资不可能是唯一的因素,因为没有大学学位的男性的工资,根据通货膨胀的调整,自1960年代起没有多少变化,因此很难理解为什么较少的男性似乎愿意接受这些工资.
cloze: While the authors of the paper found truth in this

, they assert that low wages can't be the only factor, as wages for men without college degrees, adjusting for inflation, haven't changed much since the 1960s, making it hard to see why fewer men seem willing to accept those wages.

lines.t: This leads to the second theory, that more jobs require a college degree today than in the past.
lines.zh: 这导致了第二种理论,即今天需要大学学位的工作比过去多.

lines.t: Indeed, that theory seems valid, because in America today, 2/3 of jobs are filled by workers with at least some college education.
lines.zh: 事实上,这一理论似乎是正确的,因为在今天的美国,三分之二的工作是由至少受过一些大学教育的工人填补的.
cloze: Indeed, that theory seems valid, because in America today, 2/3 of jobs are filled by workers with at least some college

lines.t: However, the authors of the paper argue that there are other factors amplifying the problem.
lines.zh: 然而,该文件的作者认为,还有其他因素加剧了这一问题.

lines.t: They identified two new potential explanations: the first being the tremendous decline in marriage among men without college degrees since the 1960s; and the second, being the increase in women participating in the workforce that was concurrent with the decline in marriage.
lines.zh: 他们确定了两个新的潜在解释:第一个解释是,自1960年代以来,没有大学学位的男子结婚人数急剧下降;第二个解释是,随着婚姻的减少,妇女加入劳动力队伍的人数有所增加.
cloze: They identified two new potential explanations: the first being the tremendous decline in marriage among men without college degrees since the 1960s; and the second, being the increase in women
in the workforce that was concurrent with the decline in marriage.

lines.t: These two changes mean that men might not have families to support, or if they do, their wives might be doing more of the providing, both of which might remove the financial incentive to work.
lines.zh: 这两项变化意味着男子可能没有家庭供养,或者如果有家庭供养,其妻子可能会做更多的供养工作,而这两种工作都可能会消除对工作的经济刺激.

lines.t: The authors of the paper concede that research on the subject isn't complete, but they argue that their work supports the value of a college education.
lines.zh: 论文的作者承认,关于这个课题的研究尚未完成,但他们认为自己的作品支持大学教育的价值.
cloze: The authors of the paper concede that research on the subject isn't complete, but they argue that their work supports the value of a college

lines.t: While an increasing number of people are trying to eat less meat, a market research team has found in its latest fashion and sustainability report that the trend is now spreading from kitchen to closet.
lines.zh: 虽然越来越多的人试图减少肉食,但市场研究小组发现,这一趋势现在正在从厨房蔓延到衣柜.
cloze: While an increasing number of people are trying to eat less meat, a market research team has found in its latest fashion and
report that the trend is now spreading from kitchen to closet.

lines.t: It found animal welfare came top of a list of issues that people considered before buying clothes, with 42% saying it was important to them.
lines.zh: 发现动物福利在购买衣服前.

lines.t: The researchers of the team predicted that the next year would see a boom in animal-free shoe collections, since they heard shoppers of all ages say they would buy footwear designated as "vegan", meaning the goods were produced without using any animal or animal part.
lines.zh: 团队的研究人员预测,明年会看到无动物鞋类收藏的兴起,因为他们听到所有年龄的店员说会购买被指定为"vegan"的鞋类,这意味着商品是在没有使用任何动物或动物部分的情况下生产的.
cloze: The researchers of the team predicted that the next year would see a boom in animal-free shoe collections, since they heard shoppers of all ages say they would buy footwear
as "vegan", meaning the goods were produced without using any animal or animal part.

lines.t: As well as being on trend, and with a much better ring to it than synthetic leather, the vegan label does convey an important extra distinction.
lines.zh: 和在趋势, 并且有一个比合成皮革更好的戒指, 素食标签确实传达了一个重要的额外区别.

lines.t: If you label something as vegan, then the whole product needs to be animal free.
lines.zh: 如果你把东西贴上素食主义者的标签,那么整个产品就需要动物自由.
cloze: If you label
as vegan, then the whole product needs to be animal free.

lines.t: That means checking things like the glue that holds the shoe together, for example, and the chemicals used for finishing them.
lines.zh: 这意味着检查诸如胶水之类的东西, 比如把鞋粘在一起, 以及用来完成这些鞋的化学品.

lines.t: At the top end, some of the world-renowned fashion designers have avoided leather and fur for some time.
lines.zh: 在顶端,一些世界知名的时装设计师在一段时间内避免了皮革和皮毛.
cloze: At the top end, some of the
fashion designers have avoided leather and fur for some time.

lines.t: In fact, some of the companies are now exploring a leather substitute and a silk replacement made from mushrooms.
lines.zh: 事实上,有些公司现在正在探索用蘑菇制成的皮革替代品和丝绸替代品.

lines.t: The Animal Free Product Society says they've seen a boom in products registered with the vegan trademark.
lines.zh: 动物自由产品协会表示,他们已经看到以素食商标注册的产品蓬勃发展.
cloze: The Animal Free Product Society says they've seen a boom in products
with the vegan trademark.

lines.t: In 2018, there were 119.
So far this year, it says an unprecedented 1,956 have been registered.
lines.zh: 今年到目前为止,登记的人数是前所未有的1 956人.
cloze: So far this year, it says an
1,956 have been registered.

lines.t: New products are being added daily.
lines.zh: 每天增加新产品.

lines.t: There are fur coats that are vegan, plastic vegan belts and shoes made from tree bark or natural rubber labeled vegan.
lines.zh: 有皮毛外衣是素食者,塑料素食带和由树皮或天然被贴上"素食"标签的橡胶所制成的鞋.
cloze: There are fur coats that are vegan, plastic vegan belts and shoes made from tree bark or
rubber labeled vegan.

lines.t: These new products aren't coming at an extra cost to consumers though.
lines.zh: 这些新产品不会给消费者带来额外的成本.

lines.t: Vegan boots cost the same as the leather originals.
lines.zh: 维干靴子和皮革原型一样昂贵.
cloze: Vegan boots cost the same as the leather

lines.t: New Look, one of the first reputable store chains to use the vegan trademark, prices ballet shoes at £7.99 and a vegan laptop handbag at £29.99, comparable with its other products.
lines.zh: New Look是最早使用素食商标的知名商店连锁店之一,以7.99英镑的价格买芭蕾舞鞋,以29.99英镑的价格买取素食笔记本电脑手提包,与它的其他产品相媲美.

lines.t: This signifies a change.
lines.zh: 这标志着一种变化.

lines.t: In the past, ethical products, whether they were fair trade or organic, came at a premium.
lines.zh: 过去,道德产品,无论是公平贸易还是有机产品,都付出了很高的代价.

lines.t: However, it is unclear whether these new products can be considered ethical.
lines.zh: 然而,尚不清楚这些新产品是否可以视为符合道德.
cloze: However, it is unclear whether these new products can be
ethical.

lines.t: The debate over durability, crop growing impacts, pollution and recyclability is a complicated one, not to mention the ethics around the working conditions for people making the products, whatever the component materials.
lines.zh: 有关耐久性、作物生长影响、污染和可回收性的辩论是复杂的,更不用说生产产品的人的工作条件的道德规范,无论材料是什么.

lines.t: Environmental campaigners advise that the best approach is to buy less, never mind what the item is made of.
lines.zh: 环保运动人士建议,最好的办法是少买东西,而不管物品是什么做的.
cloze: Environmental
advise that the best approach is to buy less, never mind what the item is made of.

lines.t: By the end of 2016, anyone who had been paying even passing attention to the news headlines was highly likely to conclude that everything was terrible, and that the world was going to hell.
lines.zh: 到2016年底,任何一直关注新闻头条的人极有可能认为一切都是可怕的,世界将陷入地狱.
cloze: By the end of 2016, anyone who had been paying even passing attention to the news headlines was highly likely to conclude that
was terrible, and that the world was going to hell.

lines.t: It was easy to feel depressed by the wars in different parts of the world, the spread of deadly viruses or terror attacks.
lines.zh: 世界各地发生的战争、致命病毒的传播或恐怖袭击很容易让人感到沮丧.

lines.t: Yet, 2016 was the best year in the history of humanity.
lines.zh: 然而,2016年是人类历史上最好的一年.
cloze: Yet, 2016 was the best year in the history of

lines.t: Child mortality was roughly half what it was as recently as 1990.
lines.zh: 儿童死亡率大约是1990年的一半.

lines.t: And 300,000 more people gained access to electricity each day.
lines.zh: 每天又有30万人获得电力.
cloze: And 300,000 more people gained access to
each day.

lines.t: Every single measure of material and environmental welfare in America, Europe, Asia, Africa and the world as a whole has improved rather than deteriorated.
lines.zh: 在美国、欧洲、亚洲、非洲和整个世界,物质和环境福利的每一项衡量都有所改善,而不是恶化.

lines.t: We are living in history's most peaceful era, with violence of all kinds in steep decline.
lines.zh: 我们生活在历史上最和平的时代,各种暴力急剧减少.
cloze: We are living in history's most peaceful era, with
of all kinds in steep decline.

lines.t: Those are the facts.
lines.zh: 这就是事实.

lines.t: So why aren't we all optimists?
lines.zh: 那为什么我们都不乐观呢?
cloze: So why aren't we all

lines.t: In a 2015 survey for YouGov, 65% of British people and 81% of the French said they thought the world was getting worse.
lines.zh: 在2015年对YouGov的调查中,65%的英国人和81%的法国人表示他们认为世界正在恶化.

lines.t: However, according to numerous sensible statistics, these people are simply wrong.
lines.zh: 然而,根据许多明智的统计数字,这些人完全是错误的.
cloze: However, according to numerous sensible
, these people are simply wrong.

lines.t: Nobody in their right mind should wish to have lived in a previous century.
lines.zh: 任何头脑正常的人都不应该希望生活在上个世纪.

lines.t: Yet people do.
lines.zh: 但人们却如此.

lines.t: Why?
lines.zh: 为什么？

lines.t: Our prevailing mood of despair is irrational.
lines.zh: 我们普遍的绝望情绪是不合理的.
cloze: Our prevailing mood of despair is

lines.t: It says more about us than it does about how things really are.
lines.zh: 它说我们比说事情的真实情况要多.

lines.t: It is best explained as the result of various psychological biases that served a purpose for our evolutionary ancestors but now, in a media-saturated era, constantly mislead us.
lines.zh: 最好的解释是,由于各种心理偏见,这些偏见对我们的进化祖先起到了作用,但在媒体饱和的时代,这种偏见不断误导我们.
cloze: It is best explained as the result of various psychological biases that served a purpose for our evolutionary ancestors but now, in a
era, constantly mislead us.

lines.t: Once upon a time, it was of great survival value to be worried about everything that could go wrong.
lines.zh: 从前,担心一切可能出错的事,对于生存来说是很有价值的.

lines.t: This is what makes bad news especially compelling.
lines.zh: 这让坏消息特别令人信服.
cloze: This is what makes bad news especially

lines.t: In our evolutionary past, it was a very good thing that our attention could be easily seized by negative information, since it might well indicate a dangerous risk to our own survival.
lines.zh: 在我们的进化历程中,一个非常好的事情是,我们的注意力很容易被负面信息所抓住,因为这很可能表明我们自己的生存面临危险.

lines.t: The caveman who always assumed there was a lion behind the next rock would usually be wrong, but he'd be much more likely to survive and reproduce than one who always assumed the opposite.
lines.zh: 一直认为下个岩石后面有一头狮子的洞穴人通常是错误的,但比起总是假设相反的洞穴人,他更可能存活和繁殖.
cloze: The caveman who always assumed there was a lion behind the next rock would usually be wrong, but he'd be much more likely to survive and
than one who always assumed the opposite.

lines.t: But that was all before newspapers, television and the internet.
lines.zh: 但这些都是报纸、电视和互联网之前的事.

lines.t: In today's hyper connected times, our addiction to bad news just leads us to vacuum up depressing or enraging stories from across the globe.
lines.zh: 在今天的超级连通时期,我们对坏消息的上瘾只会使我们对来自全球各地的令人沮丧或令人发指的故事产生真空.
cloze: In today's hyper connected times, our addiction to bad news just leads us to vacuum up
or enraging stories from across the globe.

lines.t: Whether these news stories threaten us or not, we conclude that things are much worse than they actually are.
lines.zh: 不论这些新闻报道是否威胁我们,我们得出结论,事情比实际要糟糕得多.

lines.t: Really good news, on the other hand, can be a lot harder to spot in a newspaper because predictable daily events by definition aren't news.
lines.zh: 另一方面,真正的好消息, 可能更难在报纸上看到, 因为可以预测的日常事件 顾名思义不是新闻.
cloze: Really good news, on the other hand, can be a lot harder to spot in a newspaper because
daily events by definition aren't news.

lines.t: Hi, Lily, how's the new apartment?
lines.zh: 嗨 Lily 新公寓怎么样?
cloze: Hi, Lily, how's the new

lines.t: It's okay.
lines.zh: 没关系.

lines.t: What?
lines.zh: 什么？

lines.t: How can it be just okay when last week you were thrilled about the place and kept posting photos of it online?
lines.zh: 上周你对这个地方激动不已?

lines.t: Well, last week when I moved in, the apartment seemed cozy, just the right size for one person.
lines.zh: 上周我搬进来的时候 公寓看起来很舒适 适合一个人.
cloze: Well, last week when I moved in, the
seemed cozy, just the right size for one person.

lines.t: But now it just seems tiny, shabby and solitary.
lines.zh: 但是现在它看起来很渺小,很虚弱,很孤独.

lines.t: Ah, that's the problem.
lines.zh: 这就是问题所在.

lines.t: You miss your roommates from university, don't you?
lines.zh: 你想念大学的室友吧?

lines.t: I'm going to sound like an idiot, because I used to complain to you all the time about how crowded our dormitory room was, and about all the things they did to irritate me, like watching movies late at night without headphones, or talking loudly early in the morning.
lines.zh: 我会听起来像个白痴,因为我经常向你们抱怨我们宿舍的拥挤程度,以及他们为激怒我所做的一切,比如半夜看电影时没有耳机,或者凌晨大声说话.
cloze: I'm going to sound like an idiot, because I used to complain to you all the time about how crowded our dormitory room was, and about all the things they did to irritate me, like watching movies late at night without
, or talking loudly early in the morning.

lines.t: But now I miss them terribly.
lines.zh: 但现在我非常想念他们.

lines.t: Of course you do.
lines.zh: 当然.

lines.t: That's perfectly normal.
lines.zh: 这是完全正常的.

lines.t: When I got my first place I remember thinking I couldn't wait to live by myself and get away from my juvenile roommates and all their annoying habits.
lines.zh: 当我得到我的第一个位置,我记得我想 我迫不及待地要一个人生活 远离我的少年室友 和他们所有的烦人的习惯.
cloze: When I got my first place I remember thinking I couldn't wait to live by myself and get away from my juvenile
and all their annoying habits.

lines.t: But then I began missing them and feeling lonely and thinking that our dormitory was like paradise, even though there were six of us guys in one small room.
lines.zh: 但后来我开始怀念他们,感到孤独,想着我们的宿舍就像天堂一样,尽管在一个小房间里我们有六个人.

lines.t: I thought it was just me who felt like that.
lines.zh: 我以为只有我这样觉得.

lines.t: Look, you lived at home with us, and then you had three roommates, and this is your first time living alone.
lines.zh: 听着 你和我们住在家里 然后你有三个室友 这是你第一次单独生活.

lines.t: So it's hard.
lines.zh: 故为难.

lines.t: But your first apartment is a milestone in your life, and you should celebrate it.
lines.zh: 但你的第一个公寓是人生的里程碑 你应该庆祝一下.

lines.t: Tell me about the apartment.
lines.zh: 告诉我公寓的事.

lines.t: Actually, it's not bad.
lines.zh: 其实不坏.

lines.t: In fact, it's pretty adorable, now that I have decorated it and it has everything I need.
lines.zh: 事实上,这是相当可爱的, 现在我已经装饰它, 它有我需要的一切.
cloze: In fact, it's pretty adorable, now that I have decorated it and it has
I need.

lines.t: I have a kitchen to cook in and a bathroom all to myself, and then another room with my bed at one end, and a sofa, a small table and chairs at the other end.
lines.zh: 我有一个厨房 做饭 和浴室 全部给自己, 然后另一个房间 与我的床在一端, 和沙发, 小桌子和椅子 在另一端.

lines.t: That does sound adorable and I can't wait to see it, and neither can mom and dad.
lines.zh: 听起来很可爱 我迫不及待想看 父母也一样.
cloze: That does sound
and I can't wait to see it, and neither can mom and dad.

lines.t: Welcome to our program Book Talk.
lines.zh: 欢迎来到我们的节目"书谈".
cloze: Welcome to our
Book Talk.

lines.t: Our guest today is Frank Jones, a critic of our education system, and the author of a new book, How to Reform Our Universities.
lines.zh: 我们今天的来宾是弗兰克·琼斯,他是对我们教育制度的批评家,也是新书"如何改革我们的大学"的作者.

lines.t: Hello, Susan.
lines.zh: 你好,苏珊.

lines.t: Frank, you support radically changing universities in America?
lines.zh: 弗兰克,你支持美国彻底改变的大学?

lines.t: Yes, I believe that the purpose of higher education is to prepare young people to enter the workforce, and that our current system fails to do this.
lines.zh: 是的,我认为高等教育的目的是让年轻人做好进入劳动力队伍的准备,而我们目前的制度未能做到这一点.
cloze: Yes, I believe that the purpose of higher education is to prepare young people to enter the
, and that our current system fails to do this.

lines.t: We're allocating too many resources to disciplines that don't match the needs of employers.
lines.zh: 我们为不符合雇主需要的学科分配了太多的资源.

lines.t: I think your attitude to education is a bit cynical, Frank.
lines.zh: 我觉得你对教育的态度有点愤世嫉俗,弗兰克.
cloze: I think your attitude to
is a bit cynical, Frank.

lines.t: Surely the purpose of university is to prepare young people to participate fully in civic life, rather than just to find well-paid jobs.
lines.zh: 大学的目的无疑是让年轻人做好准备,充分参与公民生活,而不是仅仅寻找报酬高的工作.

lines.t: Susan, many young graduates struggle to find any job, let alone a good one.
lines.zh: 苏珊,许多年轻的毕业生都为找到任何工作而挣扎,更不用说找一个好的工作了.
cloze: Susan, many young
struggle to find any job, let alone a good one.

lines.t: The job market is grim, particularly for students who study the arts.
lines.zh: 就业市场是严峻的,特别是对学习艺术的学生而言.

lines.t: I agree that it isn't easy for young people to find work, but you propose closing down all departments that aren't directly related to science and technology.
lines.zh: 我同意,年轻人找工作并不容易,但你建议关闭所有与科学技术没有直接关系的部门.
cloze: I agree that it isn't easy for young people to find work, but you propose closing down all
that aren't directly related to science and technology.

lines.t: Is that really the solution?
lines.zh: 这是真的解决方案吗?

lines.t: You're overstating my point.
lines.zh: 你夸大了我的观点.

lines.t: My argument is that we need to use more of our budget on areas like science and engineering.
lines.zh: 我的论点是,我们需要在科学和工程等领域使用更多的预算.

lines.t: To do that, we need to take money from subjects like literature and music.
lines.zh: 要做到这一点,我们需要从文学和音乐等学科中取钱.
cloze: To do that, we need to take money from subjects like
and music.

lines.t: But the arts have value.
lines.zh: 但艺术有价值.

lines.t: They're an important part of our culture.
lines.zh: 他们是我们文化的重要组成部分.
cloze: They're an
part of our culture.

lines.t: Studying literature or music or sculpture might not result in a job in that area, but it helps young people to think about the world in a deeper way, which makes them better citizens and makes for a better society.
lines.zh: 学习文学或音乐或雕塑可能不会在这方面产生工作,但有助于年轻人更深入地思考世界,这使他们成为更好的公民并创造更美好的社会.

lines.t: I agree that the arts are valuable to society, but it's naive to think that not only the most talented, but all students should study them at university level.
lines.zh: 我同意,艺术对社会有价值,但天真地认为,不仅最有才华,所有学生都应该在大学一级学习.
cloze: I agree that the arts are valuable to society, but it's naive to think that not only the most talented, but all students should study them at
level.

lines.t: The arts are very competitive, and most graduates will end up with a great deal of debt, obtaining a degree that has little value on the job market.
lines.zh: 艺术竞争非常激烈,大多数毕业生最终会负债累累,获得在就业市场上几乎没有价值的学位.

lines.t: Do you ever have the annoying feeling that you don't have time to really think anymore?
lines.zh: 你有那种烦人的感觉吗 你没时间再想了?
cloze: Do you ever have the
that you don't have time to really think anymore?

lines.t: You're not alone.
lines.zh: 你不是一个人.

lines.t: A variety of factors have conspired to rob us of time for reflection about ourselves and our lives.
lines.zh: 各种因素合谋剥夺了我们思考自己和我们生活的时间.
cloze: A variety of factors have conspired to rob us of time for
about ourselves and our lives.

lines.t: Today, our preoccupied minds are rarely silent.
lines.zh: 今天,我们的心思很少沉默.

lines.t: The average person receives hundreds of texts and voice messages a day, and holidays for many of us are action-packed weeks, more likely full of family activities than opportunities for tranquility and contemplation.
lines.zh: 普通人每天收到上百个短信和语音信息,我们许多人的假期都是行动周,比起安定和思考的机会,更有可能充满家庭活动.
cloze: The average person receives hundreds of texts and voice messages a day, and holidays for many of us are
more likely full of family activities than opportunities for tranquility and contemplation.

lines.t: Regular reflection, however, underlies all great professionals.
lines.zh: 然而,所有杰出的专业人员都必须经常思考.

lines.t: It's a prerequisite for you to recharge your mental batteries, see things in a new light and tap into your creativity.
lines.zh: 这是你给精神电池充电的前提, 在新光中看到东西 并挖掘你的创造力.
cloze: It's a prerequisite for you to recharge your
see things in a new light and tap into your creativity.

lines.t: Almost all of the great advisors that I have studied have found ways to get away from it all and contemplate their life and work.
lines.zh: 我所研究的几乎所有伟大的顾问都设法摆脱这一切并思考他们的生活和工作.

lines.t: Some researchers in the field of creativity, in fact, believe that insight occurs during the reflection and relaxation that follows a period of intense activity.
lines.zh: 事实上,一些创作领域的研究者认为,在经历了一段激烈活动的时期之后的反思和放松中,洞察力会发生.
cloze: Some researchers in the field of creativity, in fact, believe that insight occurs during the reflection and relaxation that follows a period of

lines.t: Schedule time for reflection about your work, or a particular project you're engaged in.
lines.zh: 考虑你的工作或你从事的某个项目的时间.

lines.t: I usually block out half an hour.
lines.zh: 我通常会堵上半小时.
cloze: I
out half an hour.

lines.t: Don't answer the phone; push your papers to the side; sketch; make lists; draw mind maps of ideas that come to you.
lines.zh: 别接电话 把你的论文推到一边 草图 列表 给大家留下思想的地图.

lines.t: At the end, write down any emerging ideas.
lines.zh: 最后,写下任何新出现的想法.
cloze: At the end, write down any

lines.t: When you're alone, stop worrying and think.
lines.zh: 当你孤独的时候, 不要担心和思考.

lines.t: A lot of our down time is spent worrying about troublesome things in our lives or fantasizing about how we'd like our lives to be.
lines.zh: 我们很多的消遣时间 都在担心我们生活中的麻烦 或者幻想我们如何生活.
cloze: A lot of our down time is spent worrying about
in our lives or fantasizing about how we'd like our lives to be.

lines.t: Revisit things during moments of relaxation, after a period of intense work.
lines.zh: 在放松的时刻,经过一段时间的紧张工作,重新审视事物.

lines.t: This is when we are the most creative.
lines.zh: 这是我们最有创意的时候.

lines.t: Even before Colorado was a state, it had post offices.
lines.zh: 甚至在科罗拉多州成为一个州之前,它就设有邮局.
cloze: Even before Colorado was a state, it had post

lines.t: The first opened in 1859 in a settlement founded by migrants searching for gold.
lines.zh: 最早于1859年在移民寻找黄金所建立的定居点开放.

lines.t: Life could be unpredictable at West—gold failed to appear, drought ruined farmers and settlers clashed with Native Americans.
lines.zh: 在西戈尔德,生活可能无法预测,干旱摧毁了农民,定居者与美洲原住民发生冲突.
cloze: Life could be
at West—gold failed to appear, drought ruined farmers and settlers clashed with Native Americans.

lines.t: On the settlement's location, now stands a sprawling university campus.
lines.zh: 在定居点的位置上,现在是一个无所不在的大学校园.

lines.t: Amid all the changes, one feature remained constant—the postal service.
lines.zh: 在所有这些变化中,一个特点保持不变——邮政服务.
cloze: Amid all the changes, one feature remained
—the postal service.

lines.t: The maps tracing America's westward expansion are telling.
lines.zh: 追踪美国向西扩张的地图有说明.

lines.t: In 1864, there were few postal branches on land controlled by Native Americans, which still accounted for most of the West.
lines.zh: 1864年,美洲原住民控制地上几乎没有邮政分行,这些分行仍然占了西方的大部分.
cloze: In 1864, there were few postal branches on land controlled by Native Americans, which still
for most of the West.

lines.t: Over the next 25 years, post offices grew quickly.
lines.zh: 在接下来的25年中,邮局发展迅速.

lines.t: Colonization of the West could be regarded as a result of big government rather than pioneers.
lines.zh: 西方的殖民可以被认为是大政府的结果,而不是先锋.
cloze: Colonization of the West could be regarded as a result of big
rather than pioneers.

lines.t: As federal subsidies and land grants tempted people into the deserts and plains, the post kept them connected.
lines.zh: 由于联邦补贴和土地赠与 诱惑人们进入沙漠和平原, 该职位保持了他们的联系.

lines.t: In the mid-19th century, the post office department was far from a centralized bureaucracy.
lines.zh: 19世纪中叶,邮局部门远非中央集权的官僚机构.
cloze: In the mid-19th century, the post office
was far from a centralized bureaucracy.

lines.t: To keep up with migration patterns, postal services were added to existing businesses.
lines.zh: 为跟上移徙模式,在现有企业中增加了邮政服务.

lines.t: The federal government commissioned private wagons to carry the mail.
lines.zh: 联邦政府委托私人货车运送邮件.
cloze: The federal government
private wagons to carry the mail.

lines.t: Short-term contracts were granted to local businessmen to act as postmasters.
lines.zh: 短期合同被授予当地商人担任邮政局长.

lines.t: These partnerships enabled the mail to quickly follow migrants, helping knit together remote parts of the country.
lines.zh: 这些伙伴关系使邮件能够迅速跟踪移徙者,帮助将该国偏远地区连接起来.
cloze: These
enabled the mail to quickly follow migrants, helping knit together remote parts of the country.

lines.t: Mr. Blevins, a digital historian, wrote a book on the history of the US postal service, he used data science to analyze historical trends.
lines.zh: 数字历史学家布莱文斯先生写了一本关于美国邮政服务历史的书,他利用数据科学来分析历史趋势.

lines.t: Most strikingly, he built an accompanying website, complete with interactive maps.
lines.zh: 最出人意料的是,他建立了一个配套网站,并配有交互式地图.
cloze: Most strikingly, he built an accompanying website, complete with
maps.

lines.t: They show readers how, within a generation, the postal service helped colonize a continent.
lines.zh: 他们向读者展示,在一代人的时间里,邮政服务如何帮助大陆殖民化.

lines.t: In last week's lecture, we discussed reasons why people forget things.
lines.zh: 在上周的讲座中,我们讨论了人们忘记事情的原因.
cloze: In last week's lecture, we
reasons why people forget things.

lines.t: This week, we will discuss a surprising reason why we might remember some things—anxiety.
lines.zh: 我们本周将讨论一个令人惊讶的原因.

lines.t: Think about something as simple as buying a coffee.
lines.zh: 想想跟买咖啡一样简单的东西.
cloze: Think about
as simple as buying a coffee.

lines.t: That may not seem like an experience that would make a deep impression on your memory, but anxiety could change that.
lines.zh: 这似乎不会给你的记忆留下深刻印象,但焦虑会改变这一点.

lines.t: In fact, a new study suggests that people with higher anxiety levels might remember certain information better than people with lower anxiety levels.
lines.zh: 事实上,一项新的研究表明,焦虑程度较高的人可能比焦虑程度较低的人更能记住某些信息.
cloze: In fact, a new study suggests that people with higher anxiety levels might remember certain
better than people with lower anxiety levels.

lines.t: That's because higher levels of anxiety may make people more susceptible to negative feelings, putting them in a more negative state of mind.
lines.zh: 这是因为更高的焦虑程度可能会使人们更容易被负面的感情所感染,使他们陷入更消极的心态.

lines.t: That in turn may make them able to better remember some events.
lines.zh: 这反过来又可能使他们能更好地回忆一些事件.
cloze: That in turn may make them able to better
some events.

lines.t: Let's take a closer look at that new study now.
lines.zh: 现在让我们仔细看看新的研究.

lines.t: In this study, the researchers started by giving 80 undergraduate students an anxiety test.
lines.zh: 在这一研究中,研究人员首先为80名本科生进行了焦虑症测试.
cloze: In this study, the researchers started by giving 80
students an anxiety test.

lines.t: The test measured the participants' anxiety levels over the preceding two weeks.
lines.zh: 测试测量了前两周参与者的焦虑程度.

lines.t: Then, to test memory, the participants were shown a series of neutral words, one at a time.
lines.zh: 后为测试记忆,学员们被展示出一连串中性文字,一次一个.
cloze: Then, to test memory, the
were shown a series of neutral words, one at a time.

lines.t: Some of the words were printed on to photos of negative scenes, meaning images that could affect their emotions negatively, such as a photo of a car accident or a cemetery.
lines.zh: 部分文字被印入负面场景相片上,意为可能对其情绪产生消极影响的画面,如车祸相片或墓地相片.

lines.t: The rest of the words were printed on to photos of neutral scenes, such as a photo of a lake or trees.
lines.zh: 其余的文字被打印到中性场景的照片上,如一幅湖或树木的照片.
cloze: The rest of the words were printed on to photos of
scenes, such as a photo of a lake or trees.

lines.t: Neutral words included words like "table" or "desk" that don't elicit emotion.
lines.zh: 中性词包括"表"或"表"等不引起情绪的词.

lines.t: Later, the participants were asked to think back to the words they were shown earlier, which caused them to reenter either a negative or a neutral mindset.
lines.zh: 后来,与会者被要求回想他们早些时候所展示的文字,这使他们重新进入了消极或中立的心态.
cloze: Later, the
were asked to think back to the words they were shown earlier, which caused them to reenter either a negative or a neutral mindset.

lines.t: The participants were then presented with another set of neutral words, and their memory of these new words was tested.
lines.zh: 随后,学员们获得了另一套中性词,并对这些新词的记忆进行了测试.

lines.t: The researchers found that the new words presented to people in a negative mindset were better remembered by people with higher levels of anxiety than those with lower levels of anxiety.
lines.zh: 研究者发现,以负面心态呈现给人们的新词被焦虑程度较高的人比焦虑程度较低的人更能记住.
cloze: The researchers found that the new words presented to people in a negative mindset were better
by people with higher levels of anxiety than those with lower levels of anxiety.

lines.t: In other words, when highly anxious individuals took in otherwise emotionally neutral information that was presented to them, it became colored by their negative mindset, making them remember the information better.
lines.zh: 换句话说,当极度焦虑的个人接受本来提供给他们的在情感上中立的信息时,就会被他们的负面心态所染色,使他们更清楚地记得这些信息.

lines.t: But these same effects were not seen in people with low levels of anxiety.
lines.zh: 但这些同样的影响在焦虑程度低的人身上没有看到.
cloze: But these same effects were not seen in people with low levels of

lines.t: Previous studies have found that extreme levels of anxiety, such as those experienced by people diagnosed with an anxiety disorder, can be quite detrimental to memory and cognitive performance.
lines.zh: 之前的研究发现,极端的焦虑程度,如被诊断出有焦虑障碍的人所经历的焦虑程度,可能对记忆和认知表现相当有害.

lines.t: But the highly anxious people in this study represent individuals who are managing their anxiety and for whom anxiety is not a serious problem.
lines.zh: 但是,本研究报告中的高度焦虑的人代表着正在处理其焦虑的个人,对于他们来说,焦虑不是一个严重的问题.
cloze: But the highly anxious people in this study represent
who are managing their anxiety and for whom anxiety is not a serious problem.

lines.t: Over the past 20 years, the internet has gradually become a dominant feature of our lives.
lines.zh: 在过去20年里,互联网逐渐成为我们生活的主导特征.
cloze: Over the past 20 years, the internet has gradually become a
feature of our lives.

lines.t: It has changed how we communicate with each other, and it has definitely transformed the way we do business with each other.
lines.zh: 它改变了我们彼此之间的交流方式,并确实改变了我们彼此之间的业务方式.

lines.t: Marketing has also changed in a number of ways.
lines.zh: 市场营销也在多方面发生了变化.
cloze: Marketing has also changed in a
of ways.

lines.t: For instance, in the past consumers had to call a phone number and patiently wait on hold, in order to get the information they wanted.
lines.zh: 例如,过去消费者必须拨打电话号码,耐心等待,以便获得他们想要的信息.

lines.t: Today, they want the information immediately.
lines.zh: 今天,他们要求立即得到信息.
cloze: Today, they want the
immediately.

lines.t: They'll go to the company's social media page and post comments and questions, expecting to receive an immediate response.
lines.zh: 他们会去公司社交媒体的网页,张贴评论和问题,期待立即得到回应.

lines.t: If they don't get their questions answered soon, they'll move on to another company that will answer them quickly.
lines.zh: 如果他们不能很快得到他们的问题的答案,他们就会转到另一家公司去迅速回答.
cloze: If they don't get their
answered soon, they'll move on to another company that will answer them quickly.

lines.t: Marketing departments today need to follow technological development.
lines.zh: 现今的营销部门要紧跟技术发展.

lines.t: For example, this year's smartphone is smarter than last year's; self-driving cars are now on the road.
lines.zh: 例如,今年的智能手机比去年更聪明;自驾车现在已经上路了.
cloze: For example, this year's smartphone is smarter than last year's;
cars are now on the road.

lines.t: Marketers have to do research on which technologies are coming into being.
lines.zh: 市场商必须研究哪些技术正在形成.

lines.t: Otherwise they risk being left behind in the virtual dust.
lines.zh: 否则他们会冒被丢在虚拟尘埃中的风险.
cloze: Otherwise they risk being left behind in the
dust.

lines.t: Marketing has also changed due to the importance of video.
lines.zh: 由于视频的重要性,营销也发生了变化.

lines.t: People don't just want to read text; they want to watch things happening.
lines.zh: 人们不只是想要阅读文字;他们想观看事物的发生.
cloze: People don't just want to read text; they want to watch things

lines.t: Companies now have to explore how they can use video on a consistent basis to share information about their businesses.
lines.zh: 公司现在必须探索如何在一致的基础上使用视频来分享有关其企业的信息.

lines.t: Fortunately, it's extremely easy to shoot something these days.

cloze: Fortunately, it's extremely easy to shoot
these days.

lines.t: All you need is a smartphone.

lines.t: But what's the result of all this?
lines.zh: 但这一切的结果是什么?

lines.t: Shorter attention spans.
lines.zh: 注意力比较短.

lines.t: We are the same people that we were 20 years ago.
lines.zh: 我们和20年前一样.

lines.t: Not only have we grown accustomed to getting the information we want instantaneously, our attention spans are much shorter.
lines.zh: 我们不仅已经习惯获得我们想要的信息, 我们的注意力跨度要短得多.

lines.t: If something doesn't capture our attention within a few seconds, we're on to the next piece of content.

engaged, they'll stick with you.

lines.t: I can't stress this enough.
lines.zh: 我压力太大了.

lines.t: I fully understand.
lines.zh: 我完全理解你的观点.

lines.t: As we all know, being such a famous football player at Real Madrid, Mr. Sanchez has a very high public profile.
lines.zh: 众所周知,桑切斯先生是皇家马德里的著名足球运动员,公众知名度很高.

and harassed.

lines.t: Yes, I completely understand how imperative it would be to respect Mr. Sanchez's private life.
lines.zh: 是的,我完全理解尊重桑切斯先生的私生活是多么必要.

lines.t: Good.
lines.zh: 不错.

lines.t: As his personal assistant, you would be required to run common everyday chores for Mr. Sanchez, things he cannot do himself due to his fame, like going to the supermarket or post office.
lines.zh: 作为他的私人助手,你需要为桑切斯先生做日常的日常活儿, 他因名气而不能自己做的事,比如去超市或邮局.

lines.t: So, well, at first sight it may appear that working for a celebrity is very glamorous.
lines.zh: 所以,乍一看,为名人工作可能非常迷人.
cloze: So, well, at first sight it may appear that working for a
is very glamorous.

lines.t: Nothing could be further from the truth.
lines.zh: 没有比事实更进一步的事了.

lines.t: I'm telling you this so that you don't get any false expectations of what the job has to offer you.
lines.zh: 我跟你说这个是为了让你不会对这份工作有什么不实的期望.
cloze: I'm telling you this so that you don't get any false
of what the job has to offer you.

lines.t: Thanks.
lines.zh: 谢谢。

lines.t: I understand this too.
lines.zh: 我也明白这一点.

lines.t: This is my first job after graduating from university.
lines.zh: 这是我大学毕业后的第一份工作.

lines.t: So frankly, I don't have much prior working experience.
lines.zh: 老实说,我以前的工作经验不多.
cloze: So frankly, I don't have much prior working

lines.t: I am, however, very excited about the prospect of joining this company and very keen to start from the bottom in whatever capacity I may be of use.
lines.zh: 然而,我对加入这个公司的前景感到非常兴奋,并且非常渴望以我可能有用的任何身份从底层开始.

lines.t: That's good to hear.
lines.zh: 赞曰.

lines.t: You sound very energetic.
lines.zh: 你听起来很有活力.

lines.t: Tell me why do you think you are well suited for this job?
lines.zh: 告诉我你为什么认为你适合这份工作?
cloze: Tell me why do you think you are well
for this job?

lines.t: Well, firstly, I love football.

lines.t: I'm a lifelong Real Madrid supporter and go to their games every weekend I can.
lines.zh: 我是真正的马德里支持者,每个周末都参加他们的比赛.
cloze: I'm a lifelong Real Madrid
and go to their games every weekend I can.

lines.t: I would simply love to have a job where I'm involved in some capacity with Real Madrid, regardless of the position and salary.
lines.zh: 我非常希望能有一份工作, 在那里我以某种身份 与皇家马德里, 无论职位和薪水.

lines.t: And secondly, I think what this company does in sports consultancy is very cool.

is very cool.

lines.zh: 我认为,我的语言能力可以证明是非常有用的.

lines.t: Adventure sports are undeniably attractive to many energetic and thrill-seeking kids.
lines.zh: 冒险运动对许多精力充沛和寻求刺激的孩子们无可否认地具有吸引力.
cloze: Adventure sports are undeniably attractive to many energetic and
kids.

lines.t: Sports like rock climbing, surfing, skiing, and mountain biking, thus have lots of appeal.
lines.zh: 诸如攀岩,冲浪,滑雪,和山地自行车等运动,因此具有很大的吸引力.

lines.t: They don't have many of the rules and pressures of traditional team sports, but they still have all the benefits of outdoor physical activity.
lines.zh: 他们虽然没有很多传统球队运动的规则和压力,但是他们仍然拥有户外体育活动的全部好处.
cloze: They don't have many of the rules and pressures of
team sports, but they still have all the benefits of outdoor physical activity.

lines.t: When properly supervised, extreme sports can be a part of a healthy, balanced life.
lines.zh: 如果受到适当的监督,极端体育可以成为健康、平衡生活的一部分.

lines.t: Some adventure sports may be associated with higher risks of injury, so it's important for kids to figure out when to take risks, and when not to.
lines.zh: 一些冒险运动可能与更高的伤害风险有关,因此孩子们必须想出何时冒险,何时不要冒险.
cloze: Some
sports may be associated with higher risks of injury, so it's important for kids to figure out when to take risks, and when not to.

lines.t: Risk-free activities deprive kids of the opportunity to test themselves and overcome their fears.
lines.zh: 无风险活动剥夺了孩子们测试自己和克服恐惧的机会.

lines.t: But to some, these very risks are what makes these sports a bad choice.
lines.zh: 但对于有些人来说,这些风险 使得这些运动成为一个糟糕的选择.
cloze: But to some, these very risks are what makes these
a bad choice.

lines.t: They say that extreme sports can often lead to devastating injuries, especially as young thrill-seekers may attempt feats that are too advanced for them.
lines.zh: 他们说,极端运动往往会导致毁灭性的伤害,特别是年轻寻求刺激的人可能试图取得对他们来说太先进的成就.

lines.t: But let's be real.
lines.zh: 但当取正相.

lines.t: Most kids do all kinds of dangerous stuff whether you want them to or not.
lines.zh: 大部分孩子都会做各种危险的事情 不管你是否愿意.

lines.t: Adventure sports have many of the same risks and dangers, but they have an additional sense of adventure, courage and autonomy that is important to foster in young children.
lines.zh: 冒险体育有许多相同的风险和危险,但它们具有额外的冒险意识,勇气和自主性,对于幼儿的培养很重要.
cloze: Adventure sports have many of the same risks and dangers, but they have an additional sense of
, courage and autonomy that is important to foster in young children.

lines.t: As always, it's up to parents to decide what's best for their kids.
lines.zh: 和往常一样,由父母决定什么最适合孩子.

lines.t: But if you do decide that adventure sports are a bit too much, do try to introduce other forms of outdoor adventures into their lives.
lines.zh: 但如果你决定冒险运动有点过分, 请尝试在他们的生活中引入其他形式的户外冒险.
cloze: But if you do decide that adventure sports are a bit too much, do try to introduce other forms of outdoor
into their lives.

lines.t: Camping under the stars, fishing, stargazing or even just playing in the woods can help a lot in building the same sense of self-confidence and risk-taking as in adventure sports.
lines.zh: 在星光下露营,钓鱼,吃星等甚至只是在树林中玩耍,可以帮助建立和冒险运动一样的自信和冒险感.

B) They help kids guard against any possible injuries
C) They rob kids of the chance to cultivate their courage
D) They deprive kids of the opportunity to develop team spirit

B) Let them participate in some less risky outdoor activities
C) Ask them to try some forms of indoor sports
D) Introduce them to these sports step by step

lines.t: The shiny gadgets of today will be waste tomorrow.
lines.zh: 今天的光辉装备明天就会被浪费.
cloze: The shiny gadgets of today will be waste

lines.t: Manufacturers don't talk much about this when they announce the big new thing that will replace your mostly just as good old thing.
lines.zh: 制造商不谈这个 当他们宣布 新的大事情, 将取代你基本上一样好的老东西.

lines.t: In fact, technology firms often purposely design devices that will not last long and cannot be repaired so that consumers will have to spend their money on a new one.
lines.zh: 事实上,技术公司往往有目的地设计不会持续很长而且无法修理的装置,以便消费者不得不将钱花在新的装置上.
cloze: In fact, technology firms often purposely design devices that will not last long and cannot be repaired so that
will have to spend their money on a new one.

lines.t: This year, the French government began requiring tech manufacturers to list a repairability score.
lines.zh: 今年,法国政府开始要求技术制造商列出可修复分数.

lines.t: If a device can be repaired, then its life can be extended, saving consumers money and the planet the burden of so many trashed gadgets.
lines.zh: 如果一个设备可以修复,那么它的寿命就可以被延长,节省消费者的钱和地球如此多被废弃的设备的负担.
cloze: If a device can be repaired, then its life can be extended, saving
money and the planet the burden of so many trashed gadgets.

lines.t: Equipped with this knowledge, consumers can make better choices about which products to buy.
lines.zh: 根据这种知识,消费者可以作出更好的选择,购买哪些产品.

lines.t: Some 59 million tons of old TVs, computers, screens, smartphones, washers and other electronics are discarded every year.
lines.zh: 每年约有5 900万吨旧电视、计算机、屏幕、智能手机、洗衣机和其他电子设备被丢弃.
cloze: Some 59 million tons of old TVs, computers, screens, smartphones, washers and other
are discarded every year.

lines.t: This waste is dangerous.
lines.zh: 这废物很危险.

lines.t: Batteries explode in recycling facilities.
lines.zh: 电池在回收设施中爆炸.

lines.t: Toxic substances like mercury leak into soil and groundwater and disperse in the air.
lines.zh: 汞等有毒物质会渗入土壤和地下水并散布于空气中.

lines.t: Manufacturing flat screens adds greenhouse gases to the atmosphere.
lines.zh: 制造平面屏幕会增加大气中的温室气体.
cloze: Manufacturing flat screens adds greenhouse gases to the

lines.t: We need tech companies to take the lead to solve this problem.
lines.zh: 我们需要技术公司带头解决这个问题.

lines.t: If they won't, governments must make them do so.
lines.zh: 如果他们不这样做,政府必须让他们这样做.
cloze: If they won't,
must make them do so.

lines.t: Although tech companies will often speak of environmental sustainability, many lobby against repair legislation, fearful it will eat into their profits.
lines.zh: 虽然科技公司会经常谈论环境可持续性,但许多反对修补立法的游说活动,担心修补会吞噬他们的利润.

lines.t: Sustainability matters, but marketable design appears to matter more to these companies.
lines.zh: 可持续性很重要,但市场化的设计似乎对这些公司更为重要.
cloze: Sustainability matters, but
design appears to matter more to these companies.

lines.t: Consumers should support right-to-repair legislation.
lines.zh: 消费者应支持关于修理权的立法.

lines.t: In this world, damage is a certainty.
lines.zh: 在这个世界上,损害是一种确定性.
cloze: In this world, damage is a

lines.t: But we cannot leave things broken: A problem of our creation is a problem that can be fixed.
lines.zh: 但我们不能让事情破碎:我们创造的问题是一个可以解决的问题.

lines.t: On average, US workers spend about 10% of their workday surfing the internet, emailing friends or shopping online.
lines.zh: 平均而言,美国工人花费了大约10%的工作日冲上网、给朋友发电子邮件或在网上购物.
cloze: On average, US workers spend about 10% of their workday surfing the internet,
friends or shopping online.

lines.t: This behavior, called cyberloafing, is believed to cost employers up to $85 billion a year in lost productivity.
lines.zh: 这种行为被称作"网购",被认为每年使雇主损失高达850亿美元的生产力.

lines.t: The majority of cyberloafing research focuses on ways to prevent employees from engaging in this behavior through interventions such as internet monitoring and computer use policies.
lines.zh: 大部分网络浏览研究侧重于通过互联网监测和计算机使用政策等干预措施防止员工参与这种行为的方法.
cloze: The majority of cyberloafing research focuses on ways to prevent employees from engaging in this behavior through
such as internet monitoring and computer use policies.

lines.t: But it turns out, such behaviors may not be a sign that a worker is lazy or just wasting time.
lines.zh: 但事实证明,这种行为可能不是工人懒惰或只是浪费时间的标志.

lines.t: Social media use at work has been linked to higher levels of employee engagement and job satisfaction.
lines.zh: 社交媒体在工作中的使用与雇员更多参与和工作满意度有关.
cloze: Social media use at work has been linked to higher levels of employee engagement and job

lines.t: New research suggests cyberloafing can help workers cope with an exceptionally stressful work environment.
lines.zh: 新的研究表明,网络浏览可以帮助工人应对异常紧张的工作环境.

lines.t: But is cyberloafing actually effective at reducing employee stress levels?
lines.zh: 但网络浏览在减少员工压力方面是否有效?
cloze: But is
actually effective at reducing employee stress levels?

lines.t: That's the question my research team wanted to answer in our new study.
lines.zh: 这是我研究团队想在新研究中回答的问题.

lines.t: Our hypothesis was that cyberloafing may serve as a mini-break, giving employees an opportunity to recover from stressful work situations.
lines.zh: 我们的假设是,网络租赁可能是一种小型破损,使雇员有机会从紧张的工作状况中恢复过来.
cloze: Our hypothesis was that cyberloafing may serve as a mini-break, giving employees an
to recover from stressful work situations.

lines.t: To test this, we asked workers to complete an online survey and rank how much time they spent cyberloafing, checking non-work emails and shopping.
lines.zh: 为了测试这一点,我们要求工人完成在线调查,并排出他们花去网络浏览、检查非工作邮件和购物的时间.

lines.t: We also asked them to rank job satisfaction, their desire to quit, and how often they've experienced mistreatment at work, such as being bullied, threatened or yelled at.
lines.zh: 我们还要求他们把工作满意程度,辞去职务的欲望,以及他们在工作中遭受过多少虐待,如被欺负,被威胁或被骂.
cloze: We also asked them to rank job satisfaction, their desire to quit, and how often they've experienced
at work, such as being bullied, threatened or yelled at.

lines.t: As you might expect, we found that overall, more mistreatment at work was correlated with lower levels of job satisfaction and a greater desire to quit.
lines.zh: 正如你可能预料的那样,我们发现,总的来说,更多的工作虐待与工作满意度较低和更加渴望辞职有关.

lines.t: More interestingly, we found that cyberloafing effectively buffered this connection.
lines.zh: 更有趣的是,我们发现网络浏览能有效地缓冲这种连接.
cloze: More interestingly, we found that
effectively buffered this connection.

lines.t: That is, mistreated workers who spent more time surfing the web and checking emails reported higher job satisfaction and were less likely to want to quit than similar participants who didn't cyberloaf as much.
lines.zh: 也比不上网络浏览的类似参与者.

lines.t: This suggests that cyberloafing acts as a sort of relief valve for workers, helping them recover from stressful experiences.
lines.zh: 这表明网络浏览对工人起到某种救济阀的作用,帮助他们从紧张的经历中恢复过来.
cloze: This suggests that
acts as a sort of relief valve for workers, helping them recover from stressful experiences.

lines.t: While we did not directly assess how cyberloafing affects worker performance, we believe by relieving stress it may not only reduce worker turnover, but also ultimately bolster productivity.
lines.zh: 虽然我们没有直接评估网络租赁如何影响工人的业绩,但我们认为,通过减轻压力,不仅可以减少工人的更替,而且最终可以提高生产力.

lines.t: This fits with other recent research that suggests taking short breaks is associated with higher levels of daily job performance.
lines.zh: 这与最近的其他研究相匹配,这些研究显示,休息时间很短,这与提高日常工作业绩有关.
cloze: This fits with other recent research that suggests taking short breaks is associated with higher levels of daily job

lines.t: That isn't to say cyberloafing is always good.
lines.zh: 这不是说网络浏览总是好的.

lines.t: Too much time spent on non-work activities likely causes performance to suffer.
lines.zh: 花费过多时间从事非工作活动可能会导致业绩受损.
cloze: Too much time spent on non-work activities likely causes
to suffer.

lines.t: All in all, managers should be more lenient with employees.
lines.zh: 总之,管理人员应该对雇员更加宽容.

lines.t: We believe a bit of online shopping or surfing the internet at work could make workers more productive in the long run.
lines.zh: 我们相信网上购物或上网.
cloze: We believe a bit of online shopping or surfing the internet at work could make workers more
in the long run.

lines.t: When Julius Morton moved to Nebraska City in 1854, he faced a problem shared by many settlers in the territory: It was a treeless plain.
lines.zh: 当朱利叶斯·莫顿于1854年迁入内布拉斯加州城时,他面临着一个与该地许多定居者共同的问题: 那是一片没有树的平原.
cloze: When Julius Morton moved to Nebraska City in 1854, he faced a problem shared by many settlers in the
: It was a treeless plain.

lines.t: That meant no trees for building materials, or for fuel.
lines.zh: 这意味着没有树木用于建材或燃料.

lines.t: But Morton was one of the world's first conservationists, stating, "For prosperity, we ought to plant as many forests as we have exhausted and consumed".
lines.zh: 但莫顿是世界上最早的保护主义者之一,称"为了繁荣,我们应该种植所耗尽和消耗的森林".
cloze: But Morton was one of the world's first
, stating, "For prosperity, we ought to plant as many forests as we have exhausted and consumed".

lines.t: So he started planting trees, beginning with his own land.
lines.zh: 于是他开始植树,从他自己的土地开始.

lines.t: By 1860 Morton possessed a forest of more than 300 trees.
lines.zh: 到1860年,莫顿拥有了由300多棵树组成的森林.
cloze: By 1860 Morton
a forest of more than 300 trees.

lines.t: A few years later, he had more than 1,000.
lines.zh: 几年后,他拥有1000多所.

lines.t: As the forest grew, so did Morton's influence in Nebraska.
lines.zh: 随着森林的生长,莫顿在内布拉斯加州的影响力也一样.
cloze: As the forest grew, so did Morton's
in Nebraska.

lines.t: This was largely because Morton founded the Nebraska City News, the state's first newspaper, in which he frequently wrote editorials about the practical and aesthetic benefits of tree planting.
lines.zh: 这主要是因为莫顿创办了"内布拉斯加州城市新闻",这是该州的第一家报纸,他在其中经常写出社论,讲述植树的实际和美学好处.

lines.t: He also organized the Nebraska State Gardening Society and served on the Nebraska State Board of Agriculture.
lines.zh: 他还组织了"内布拉斯加州园林学会"并担任了内布拉斯加州农业委员会.
cloze: He also organized the Nebraska State Gardening Society and served on the Nebraska State Board of

lines.t: While serving on the Board, Morton came up with an idea to spread his belief in tree planting statewide.
lines.zh: 在担任董事会委员期间,莫顿想出一个想法,将自己对全州植树的信念传播开来.

lines.t: On January 4, 1872, Morton drafted a resolution that April 10 be designated day for the planting of trees in the State of Nebraska and urged people to go out and plant trees themselves.
lines.zh: 1872年1月4日,莫顿起草决议,指定4月10日为在内布拉斯加州植树日,并敦促人们出外自行植树.
cloze: On January 4, 1872, Morton drafted a resolution that April 10 be designated day for the planting of trees in the State of Nebraska and urged people to go out and plant trees

lines.t: Morton called the special event Arbor Day as "arbor" is Latin for "tree".
lines.zh: 莫顿称特别活动"Arbor Day"为"arbor"是拉丁文为"tree".

lines.t: The state government agreed.
lines.zh: 州政府表示同意.

lines.t: And on April 10, 1872, the first unofficial Arbor Day was celebrated throughout Nebraska.
lines.zh: 而在1872年4月10日,第一个非正式的Arbor日被庆祝到整个内布拉斯加州.

lines.t: Prizes were awarded to counties, cities, and individuals who planted the largest number of trees.
lines.zh: 获奖的县,市,个人植树最多.
cloze: Prizes were awarded to counties, cities, and
who planted the largest number of trees.

lines.t: That day, an astounding one million trees were planted in Nebraska—an average of more than six for every man, woman and child in the state.
lines.zh: 当天,内布拉斯加州种植了一百万棵惊人的树木,平均每名男子、妇女和儿童种植六棵以上.

lines.t: Since 1885, Nebraska has planted more than 700,000 acres of trees, earning it the nickname "the Tree Planters State".
lines.zh: 1885年起,内布拉斯加州种植了超过70万英亩的树木,为它赢得了"树木栽培者国家"的外号.
cloze: Since 1885, Nebraska has planted more than 700,000 acres of trees,
it the nickname "the Tree Planters State".

lines.t: Arbor Day became a legal, civic holiday in the state in 1885.
lines.zh: Arbor Day在1885年成为了该州的合法,公民假日.

lines.t: It was held on April 22—Julius Morton's birthday.
lines.zh: 它于4月22日举行——尤利乌斯·莫顿的生日.
cloze: It was held on April 22—Julius Morton's

lines.t: In addition to a parade in Nebraska City, Morton introduced what has since become a long-standing Arbor Day tradition: Schoolchildren went outside and planted trees together.
lines.zh: 除了在内布拉斯加州市的游行之外,莫顿还引入了从此成为长期Arbor Day传统的东西:在校生出门一起种植树木.

lines.t: In 1970, nearly a century after Arbor Day was first celebrated, President Richard Nixon declared the last Friday of every April to be observed as National Arbor Day.
lines.zh: 1970年,在阿尔博尔日被首次庆祝近一个世纪后,理查德·尼克松总统宣布每年4月的最后星期五被纪念为"国家阿尔博尔日".
cloze: In 1970, nearly a century after Arbor Day was first
, President Richard Nixon declared the last Friday of every April to be observed as National Arbor Day.

lines.t: All 50 states recognize the April observance, although many hold an additional state Arbor Day in a month more suited to local tree planting.
lines.zh: 所有50个州都承认了4月的纪念活动,尽管许多州会在一个月内再举办一个更适合当地植树的州会日.

lines.t: Modern humans arose in Africa about 200,000 years ago.
lines.zh: 现代人类大约在20万年前在非洲兴起.

lines.t: They then spread across Europe and Asia sometime after 60,000 years ago.
lines.zh: 它们在60,000年前的某个时候扩散到欧洲和亚洲.

lines.t: This is the "Out of Africa" model, as it's commonly known.
lines.zh: 这是"出自非洲"的模式,俗称"出自非洲".

lines.t: In the 1990s, the hypothesis found widespread acceptance.
lines.zh: 1990年代,该假说被广泛接受.

lines.t: But this popular idea is in need of revision, particularly given the number of important findings across Asia over the past few decades.
lines.zh: 但这一受欢迎的想法需要修改,特别是鉴于过去几十年亚洲各地的重要调查结果很多.
cloze: But this popular idea is in need of revision, particularly given the number of
findings across Asia over the past few decades.

lines.t: For instance, many new human fossils found, particularly in China, are now dated as older than 60,000 years.
lines.zh: 例如,特别是在中国发现的许多新的人类化石现在已有60 000多年前的历史.

lines.t: This calls into question the idea that modern humans migrated out of Africa only 60,000 years ago.
lines.zh: 这使人们质疑现代人类仅在6万年前迁出非洲的想法.
cloze: This calls into question the idea that modern humans
out of Africa only 60,000 years ago.

lines.t: Take the recent discovery of two modern human teeth found in the Luna cave in China's Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region.
lines.zh: 取中国广西壮族自治区月花洞出土的两颗近代人牙.

lines.t: When my research team and I dated these teeth, we found they were more than 70,000 years old—a situation clearly impossible if modern humans moved out of Africa only 60,000 years ago.
lines.zh: 当我的研究团队和我约会这些牙齿时,我们发现它们已经超过7万岁了——如果现代人类仅仅在6万年前离开非洲,这种情况显然是不可能的.
cloze: When my research team and I dated these teeth, we found they were more than 70,000 years old—a situation clearly
if modern humans moved out of Africa only 60,000 years ago.

lines.t: So with such findings, what happened exactly?
lines.zh: 因此,有了这样的发现,到底发生了什么?

lines.t: Where does the most current data suggest we came from?
lines.zh: 最新数据显示我们来自哪里?
cloze: Where does the most current data
we came from?

lines.t: The first question we should ask is why did modern humans leave Africa to begin with?
lines.zh: 我们应该问的第一个问题是,为什么现代人类首先离开非洲?

lines.t: If a population is perfectly adapted to a particular environment and has access to an abundance of resources, then there really is no reason to move or change.
lines.zh: 如果某一人口完全适应特定环境,并且能够获得丰富的资源,那么,确实没有理由迁移或改变.
cloze: If a population is perfectly adapted to a particular
and has access to an abundance of resources, then there really is no reason to move or change.

lines.t: For instance, some monkeys in Africa have a set of teeth that has hardly changed over the course of millions of years, indicating that they found a place that has worked for them.
lines.zh: 例如,非洲的一些猴子的牙齿在数百万年中几乎没有改变,这表明他们找到了一个为他们工作的地方.

lines.t: So what happened with humans?
lines.zh: 人类怎么了?

lines.t: Some researchers have suggested that population density increased to the point where smaller human groups were forced to explore new lands.
lines.zh: 一些研究者建议人口密度会增加,以至于较小的人类群体被迫去探索新地.

lines.t: Other researchers have suggested that due to major environmental events in East Africa, humans were prompted to find greener pastures.
lines.zh: 其他研究者提出,由于东非的重大环境事件,促使人类去寻找更绿色的牧场.
cloze: Other researchers have suggested that due to major
events in East Africa, humans were prompted to find greener pastures.

lines.t: Yet another explanation could simply be that early modern human hunters were following the large animals that they relied on, and so they moved out of Africa without realizing that they were actually moving from one continent to another.
lines.zh: 另一种解释可能只是,早期的现代人类猎人正在跟踪他们所依赖的大型动物,所以他们搬出非洲,却没有意识到他们实际上正在从一个大陆迁移到另一个大陆.

lines.t: Humans need daily access to reliable fresh water, which appears to be absent from many coastal areas.
lines.zh: 人类每天需要获得可靠的淡水,许多沿海地区似乎没有这种水.
cloze: Humans need daily access to reliable fresh water, which appears to be absent from many
areas.

lines.t: This brings us to another question: by which route did modern humans move out of Africa?
lines.zh: 这又给我们带来了另一个问题:现代人类从非洲迁出的途径是什么?

lines.t: No clear routes across the Mediterranean from North Africa appear to be present, so the earlier dispersals out of Africa and into Europe and Asia might have been across the Arabian Peninsula.
lines.zh: 似乎没有从北非穿越地中海的明确路线,因此,早先从非洲向外扩散,进入欧洲和亚洲,可能已经跨越了阿拉伯半岛.
cloze: No clear routes across the Mediterranean from North Africa appear to be present, so the earlier
out of Africa and into Europe and Asia might have been across the Arabian Peninsula.
